links.outcome: Consistency of chatbot answer accuracy when low-scoring questions were requeried 8 to 17 days later
links.effect: 34 of 36 low-scoring questions (1.0-2.0) were requeried; median accuracy rose from 2.0 (IQR 1.0-3.0) to 4.0 (IQR 2.0-5.3), P < .01, showing answers varied on repeat.
links.quote: Of 36 questions with scores of 1.0 to 2.0, 34 were requeried or regraded 8 to 17 days later with substantial improvement (median score 2.0 [IQR, 1.0-3.0] vs 4.0 [IQR, 2.0-5.3]; P < .01).

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the accuracy and completeness of ChatGPT (GPT-3.5 and GPT-4) on physician-generated medical queries graded by specialist physicians, but does not test a deployment practice or organizational safeguard.
